title: Breathing Mars — the real story: making oxygen from Martian air

lines.en: Martian air is about 95% carbon dioxide, and far too thin to breathe.
lines.tts: Martian air is about ninety-five percent carbon dioxide, and far too thin to breathe.
lines.es: El aire de Marte es cerca de 95 % dióxido de carbono, y demasiado tenue para respirar.

lines.en: Could we make our own oxygen there?
In 2021, a box the size of a car battery rode to Mars inside the Perseverance rover: MOXIE.
lines.tts: In twenty twenty-one, a box the size of a car battery rode to Mars inside the Perseverance rover: Moxie.
lines.es: En 2021, una caja del tamaño de una batería de auto viajó a Marte dentro del rover Perseverance: MOXIE.

lines.en: Between 2021 and 2023 it ran 16 times and made 122 grams of oxygen, up to 12 grams an hour.
lines.tts: Between twenty twenty-one and twenty twenty-three it ran sixteen times and made one hundred and twenty-two grams of oxygen, up to twelve grams an hour.
lines.es: Entre 2021 y 2023 funcionó 16 veces y fabricó 122 gramos de oxígeno, hasta 12 gramos por hora.

lines.en: Inside, a compressor squeezes the thin air, and a ceramic cell heated to 800 degrees splits each carbon dioxide molecule.
lines.tts: Inside, a compressor squeezes the thin air, and a ceramic cell heated to eight hundred degrees splits each carbon dioxide molecule.
lines.es: Dentro, un compresor aprieta el aire tenue y una celda cerámica calentada a 800 grados separa cada molécula de dióxido de carbono.

lines.en: Oxygen goes one way. Carbon monoxide goes back to the air.
lines.es: El oxígeno sale por un lado. El monóxido de carbono vuelve al aire.

scenes.kicker: FROM A BOX TO A BASE
scenes.title: How much oxygen do explorers need?

lines.en: A person breathes under a kilogram of oxygen a day. A rocket leaving Mars needs about 25 tonnes.
lines.tts: A person breathes under a kilogram of oxygen a day. A rocket leaving Mars needs about twenty-five tonnes.
lines.es: Una persona respira menos de un kilo de oxígeno al día. Un cohete que deja Marte necesita unas 25 toneladas.

lines.en: Now compare your plant. Every kilogram made there is a kilogram you don't carry from Earth.
lines.es: Ahora compara tu planta. Cada kilo fabricado allá es un kilo que no cargas desde la Tierra.

scenes.quote: We used to ask if Mars could hold life. Now we ask if it can help us live.
scenes.learn: NASA/JPL: MOXIE final results (2023) · NASA: in-situ resource utilisation (ISRU) · NASA: Mars 2020 Perseverance rover

lines.en: We used to ask if Mars could hold life. Now we ask if it can help us live.
lines.es: Antes preguntábamos si Marte podía albergar vida. Ahora preguntamos si puede ayudarnos a vivir.
